src_members.sig: public static T WeightedPick<T>(IReadOnlyList<(T item, float weight)> options)
src_members.name: WeightedPick
src_members.comment: Picks one item from a list based on relative weights (they don't need to sum to 1) — the standard loot-table pattern: WeightedPick(new[]{("Common",70f),("Rare",25f),("Legendary",5f)}).

src_members.sig: public static bool Chance(float probability01) => Random.value < probability01
src_members.name: Chance
src_members.comment: true with the given probability, e.g. Chance(0.25f) for a 25% chance.

src_members.name: RollDice
src_members.comment: Parses and rolls simple dice notation ("2d6" -> sum of two 1-6 rolls, "1d20"/"d20" -> one 1-20 roll).

src_members.sig: public static float NextGaussian(float mean = 0f, float stdDev = 1f)
src_members.name: NextGaussian
src_members.comment: Box-Muller transform: converts uniform randomness into a normal (bell-curve) distribution — use for "usually near the average, rarely extreme" values (loot rolls, stat variance) instead of the flat feel of plain Random.Range.
